keys.name: stand
keys.pose: Home: she stands beside what she built, arms easy, looking at it.
keys.changes: Home: she stands beside what she built, arms easy, looking at it.

keys.name: settle
keys.pose: She turns to the patch she will sit on, weight settling onto the back foot: the hips have only begun to sink.
keys.changes: She turns to the patch she will sit on, weight settling onto the back foot: the hips have only begun to sink.

keys.name: seat
keys.pose: Seated on the patch, forearms on her knees: she is the lowest she is in the second half.
keys.changes: Seated on the patch, forearms on her knees: she is the lowest she is in the second half.

keys.name: window
keys.pose: One last look through the frame, now a window, from where she sits: she leans a little toward it.
keys.changes: One last look through the frame, now a window, from where she sits: she leans a little toward it.
